title: Asynchronous Decoupled Zswap Speculative Prefetch
headline: Screening benchmark: asynchronous background zswap prefetch unblocks the faulting thread with -5.0% random p99 latency reduction and +1.48% geomean gain.

sections.title: Eliminating synchronous decompression latency bursts in speculative swapin
sections.lead: Standard swap readahead speculatively decompresses multiple neighboring slots synchronously during page faults, stalling the faulting thread. Candidate exp3-async-zswap-prefetch-v1 decouples speculative zswap readahead into a background workqueue, unblocking the faulting thread immediately.

blocks.text: Hypothesis 3 synchronously loads only the demanded order-0 folio via swap_cache_read_folio_sync, while speculative neighboring swap slots are batched and dispatched to a dedicated background workqueue (zswap_prefetch_wq). Evaluated under Protocol Revision 7 with attributable metadata accounting.

sections.title: Zswap readahead path and background prefetch queue
sections.lead: Page fault handlers trigger swap readahead. Decoupled prefetch separates the synchronous critical demand path from speculative background decompression.

blocks.takeaway: Faulting thread returns immediately after synchronous load of demanded folio

sections.title: Decoupled dispatch in swap_vma_readahead and swap_cluster_readahead
sections.lead: Demanded slot synchronously loaded via swap_cache_read_folio_sync; speculative slots batched into struct zswap_prefetch_batch and queued to zswap_prefetch_wq.

blocks.takeaway: Speculative entries are batched and scheduled to background work function

sections.title: Modifications in mm/swap_state.c
sections.lead: Added zswap_prefetch_batch, zswap_prefetch_work_fn, zswap_prefetch_wq; modified swap_vma_readahead and swap_cluster_readahead to synchronously return the demanded folio and asynchronously prefetch speculative slots.

blocks.takeaway: Background worker warms swap cache without delaying faulting thread

sections.title: Architectural decision: exploratory screening completed
sections.lead: Candidate passed all 17 correctness gates, probe calibration, and fast screening benchmark (+1.48% gain, -5.0% random p99 latency). Benign complexity vs benefit ratio designated research disposition as rejected while preserving candidate as frontier-eligible.

blocks.text: Asynchronous prefetch proves the decoupled loading concept, reducing random swapin tail latency. Future work could pair this mechanism with adaptive stride gating to avoid queueing unused speculative slots.
